description: This file contains helper constants, data class definitions, and mappings related to Intrinio financial data, including sources, venues, ETF exchanges, performance metrics, and data models for companies and securities.

classes.name: IntrinioCompany
classes.description: Data model representing an Intrinio company with fields for ID, ticker, name, LEI, and CIK.

classes.name: IntrinioSecurity
classes.description: Data model representing an Intrinio security with fields for ID, company ID, name, code, currency, ticker, FIGI identifiers, and primary listing status.
